reviews.x: i LITERALLY only had this ring on for 20 minutes until the metal spontaneously broke in half. i have size 7 fingers so i dont think it was because i had fat fingers ;).... you get what you pay for!

Well, the ring was SUPER cute. I had it maybe a little less than 24 hours before I tried adjusting it and it snapped! I wasn't expecting much because I DID read the reviews before I bought it, but I take part in responsibility because I did bend it to adjust it... oh well. I guess if you can handle not bending it, it's a really cute and good buy, cheap and cute, but NOT the best quality!

I reallllllly like this ring. I had it for 5 days, wearing it daily but taking it off for bed, showers, to wash hands, etc. However on the 4th day, it broke in half! I didn't even bend it a lot, like at all. And it just broke. I don't recommend this ring.

reviews.t: I'm very disappointed. I stretched it a little to be able ...
reviews.x: I'm very disappointed. I stretched it a little to be able to put it on my finger because it says "adjustable". But when I did, the ring snapped right in half! Very unhappy and I will not be buying anything from this seller again.

reviews.t: Want to be let down once again? Buy this ring!
reviews.x: It arrived broken and appeared to be made more cheaply than a ring from a cracker jack box. I was excited and instead of getting a super cute ring all I got was disappointment. Thanks Bangood for sending me disappointment for a fee.
it's really simple and pretty, it went untracked so I didn't get track info.I ordered it July 14 and it came the 24th.its actually small it only fits on my ring finger and its difficult to get off.

I bought one of these and it was broken right out of the package, so the second one I ordered broke when I tried to tighten it to my finger.  So the 3rd one I got I just gave to my sister and told her good luck!  Bangood was very quick and responded kindly with the issues that I was having so even though I didn't get to have this ring I wouldn't hesitate ordering from them again.  It looks A LOT stronger and sturdier than it really is!  The detail is done very well too.  Just don't try and adjus

Bought 2.  Fit early college age daughter perfectly and did not need to be adjusted.  She loved them.  However, both snapped (broke) in the first week of minimal use.  Very brittle material.  A ring should be somewhat malleable, but never brittle/fragile.  For $2 each, what can I expect.  Shipped directly from China quickly.

reviews.t: I've been wearing this ring pretty much all day every day for a couple weeks ...
reviews.x: I've been wearing this ring pretty much all day every day for a couple weeks now and its holding up pretty nicely. I've bought rings in the past that have gotten caught on things and bent a little and then end up breaking but I've worn this on my middle finger and even loosened it a tiny tiny amount so it was more comfortable and have not had any problems. I even received the item pretty fast in the mail. The only problem is the silver color didn't last very long. Within a day or two of wearing

I fell in love with the ring the moment I took it out of the package. I have about a size 5 or 6 finger, and the ring fit without any adjustments needed. My only complaint is that it turns my finger green whenever I wear it, and the silver faded away. Now it's half silver and half brown. Other than that, I am extremely happy with the purchase.

For a cheap ring, it was pretty good. It did turn my finger green after wearing it all day, and I have noticed the coating coming off, but I put a layer of clear nail polish to prevent that, and it seems to be working nicely. It is cute, and I love it for the price.

If there were negative stars for this ring, I would rate this a -5 star product. No sooner did I take it out of the package and barely bend it to fit my finger, it broke in two. Even if it was inexpensive, it's not even worth the little money I did spend on it.

I love this ring, however, I have bought 2 of them and they seem to have a weak spot and break. I won't waste anymore money buying something that keeps breaking and only after about 3 times of wear. And not going periods of time. But I love how it looks.

reviews.t: I thought this ring would be as big as the ...
reviews.x: I thought this ring would be as big as the picture but it's actually quite small and bendable. It took a few weeks before I recieved it, just before my niece's birthday. I ordered it as a gift for her because it was on her wish list. I hope she likes it.

This ring's color will wipe away since the actual ring is made of copper. My biggest advice when you get the ring is when you adjust it to your ring size; put a few coats of clear nail polish over it. Works every time.

reviews.t: I really liked the idea of this ring and it did ship ...
reviews.x: I really liked the idea of this ring and it did ship faster than expected but when I got it I had to shape it to fit my finger and with in 20 mins it broke in two not happy cheaper than a 25¢ vending machine

For all the reviews saying it rusted easily, an easy fix that worked for me was covering the ring in clear nail polish. The reason I am rating this so low is because it is easily breakable so be careful!

I knew it was going to be a cheapie ring, but I thought the faux silver would last a LITTLE longer than one day .. most of it has rubbed off now, except for the arrow portion. Glad it didn't cost much!

reviews.t: Terrible quality, but you usually end up getting what ...
reviews.x: Ring broke after playing with it on my finger. Terrible quality, but you usually end up getting what you pay for. So if your looking to wear a ring twice for the cheap price, this ring is for you.
... until it broke as I opened a bottle of water. Yes, it literally broke in half, right through the band. Too bad; this should've been a cute trend piece I'd have for at least a little while.

Looked super cute on till 3 hours later when it broke in half. Got to wear it once.... I cannot believe that this ring couldn't make it a full day. Super disappointed

claims.text: Many reviewers report the ring breaks or snaps easily, often within days or immediately after adjusting it.
Several reviewers describe the ring as cute and affordable despite its fragility.
Some reviewers note the ring turns their finger green and the color/coating fades or wipes off.
A few reviewers mention the ring is smaller than expected or difficult to fit and remove.
Some reviewers say the ring arrived already broken or made of very cheap, brittle material.
